verdicts.note: Repeatedly self-identifies as female designer; quote 'I was the only female in cosmetics' confirms female.
Design Development team, design degree throughout; Design & Technology is the right dept.
Whole interview is about her current placement ('going back next year', final year next); placement year correct.
Clearly currently on placement at the company; yes is correct.
Names money as the main benefit of the placement; supports agree (adjacent to 'need money' but supportive).
Values new skills and manufacturing knowledge gained; supports agree on work experience.
Quote about seeing things made and understanding processes directly maps to 'what industry is really like'.
Quote is about accepting a future job at the firm for security, not that the placement improves chances of getting a job; does not support this item.
Placement highlighted likes/dislikes and future direction; supports agree.
Clear growth in confidence ('I've been told my confidence has grown'); supports personal development.
Explicitly will NOT base final-year project on placement; supports disagree.
Credits course presentations/communicating ideas as very helpful; supports course develops interpersonal skills.
Contrasts self-interested uni work ('trying to get one thing for yourself') with less competitive work; supports agree uni students are competitive.
Describes uni group work as stressful, unfair, difficult, with bad experiences; supports dissatisfied.
Frames the many different modules positively; supports satisfied with subject variety.
Finds the field 'much more exciting than so many other jobs'; indirect (about industry, not 'pleased I chose to study') but supports agree at medium.
